issues.problem: Going from $391.0B to $416.2B is growth of about 6.4%, not 15% (or 1.5%).

data.summary: All dollar figures (revenue $416.2B, prior-year $391.0B, net income $112.0B, operating income $133.1B, total assets $359.2B, cash $35.9B) match Apple's FY2025 results, but the stated growth rate is wrong; the actual figure is about 6.4%.
